nodes.label: Single-Source skillMatches Cross-Surface Filter Parity
nodes.rationale: Exports skillMatches() at src/web/page.ts module scope and interpolates its transpiled .toString() into APP_JS so web and TUI share one filter predicate (including agents in the web haystack); enforced by node --check, sha256 script pinning, and 12x3 cross-surface parity tests.

nodes.label: Esc-Keeps-Text Input Rule and 3-Mode Checked-First Sort
nodes.rationale: Aligns web Escape handlers with help documentation by keeping filter and search query text on Escape, removes dead duplicate checkForUpdates code, and flips default web sort to checked-first with A-to-Z tiebreak matching the TUI while providing real A-Z and load-order modes.
